EntityRef.description:
EntityRef represents a fully-resolved financial entity cross-reference.
 All identifier fields are optional; at least `name` is always populated.

items.description: Data sources used for this resolution (e.g. "finnhub", "openfigi", "gleif", "convex_cache").

Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

LookupByLeiRequest.description: LookupByLei — direct LEI lookup without auto-detection.

ResolveEntityRequest.description: ResolveEntity — resolve any identifier to a full EntityRef.

q.description: Freeform query — type detected automatically by format.

ticker.description:
Provide exactly one of the following identifiers.
 If multiple are provided, priority: ticker > isin > lei > q.

SearchEntitiesRequest.description: SearchEntities — full-text search across cached entity names.

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.

get.description: LookupByLei directly resolves a Legal Entity Identifier.
ResolveEntity resolves any identifier to a full EntityRef.

parameters.description:
Provide exactly one of the following identifiers.
 If multiple are provided, priority: ticker > isin > lei > q.
parameters.name: ticker

parameters.description: Freeform query — type detected automatically by format.
parameters.name: q

get.description: SearchEntities searches cached entities by name fragment.
